
<!-- Partial: psychographic profiling of agents. -->

This section implements the outline's **Psychographic Profiling of Agents** task.

- Fine-tune one suggested resource (**GoEmotions**) in a compact training run.
- Run the resulting model, together with additional suggested pretrained models, on Moltbook posts.
- Build post-level and agent-level psychographic outputs.

The post-level output explicitly includes identifiers for **agent** and **submolt**, as required by the outline.

```{python}
#| label: profile-load-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

from os import getenv

import pandas as pd
from dotenv import load_dotenv

from utils import Data, ROOT

load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env", override=False)
print(f"HF_TOKEN found: {bool(getenv('HF_TOKEN'))}")

data = Data().load("norm")
_posts_profile = data.posts.copy()

if _posts_profile is None or _posts_profile.empty:
    raise ValueError("No posts found in `norm` dataset.")
if "agent" not in _posts_profile.columns:
    raise ValueError("Expected `agent` column on posts for profiling.")

text_col = next((c for c in ["normalized", "post_normalized", "post", "content"] if c in _posts_profile.columns), None)
if text_col is None:
    raise ValueError("Could not find a text column in posts.")

_posts_profile[text_col] = _posts_profile[text_col].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
_posts_profile = _posts_profile[_posts_profile[text_col].str.len() >= 20].copy()

MAX_PROFILE_POSTS = 1_000
if len(_posts_profile) > MAX_PROFILE_POSTS:
    _posts_profile = _posts_profile.sample(n=MAX_PROFILE_POSTS, random_state=42).copy()
    print(f"Sampling posts for profiling: {MAX_PROFILE_POSTS:,}")

if "submolt" not in _posts_profile.columns:
    _posts_profile["submolt"] = "(missing)"
if "post_id" not in _posts_profile.columns:
    _posts_profile = _posts_profile.reset_index(drop=False).rename(columns={"index": "post_id"})

print(f"Posts available for psychographic inference: {len(_posts_profile):,}")
print(f"Text column: {text_col!r}")
```

```{python}
#| label: profile-finetune-goemotions
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import numpy as np
import torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import (
    AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
    AutoTokenizer,
    DataCollatorWithPadding,
    Trainer,
    TrainingArguments,
)

BASE_MODEL = "distilbert-base-uncased"
FT_DIR = ROOT / "artifacts" / "goemotions-distilbert"
FT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

go = load_dataset("go_emotions", "raw")
# Support both GoEmotions schemas:
# - sequence labels column (`labels`)
# - one-hot emotion columns in `raw` config.
if "labels" in go["train"].column_names:
    label_names = go["train"].features["labels"].feature.names

    def _to_single_label(ex):
        lbs = ex["labels"]
        ex["label"] = int(lbs[0]) if lbs else -1
        return ex

    go_train = go["train"].map(_to_single_label).filter(lambda x: x["label"] >= 0)
    if "validation" in go:
        go_eval = go["validation"].map(_to_single_label).filter(lambda x: x["label"] >= 0)
    else:
        split = go_train.train_test_split(test_size=0.1, seed=42)
        go_train, go_eval = split["train"], split["test"]
else:
    META_COLS = {
        "text",
        "id",
        "author",
        "subreddit",
        "link_id",
        "parent_id",
        "created_utc",
        "rater_id",
        "example_very_unclear",
    }
    label_names = [c for c in go["train"].column_names if c not in META_COLS]
    if not label_names:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not infer emotion columns from GoEmotions dataset.")

    def _to_single_label(ex):
        vals = [int(ex.get(k, 0)) for k in label_names]
        if sum(vals) <= 0:
            ex["label"] = -1
        else:
            ex["label"] = int(np.argmax(vals))
        return ex

    train_all = go["train"].map(_to_single_label).filter(lambda x: x["label"] >= 0)
    if "validation" in go:
        go_eval = go["validation"].map(_to_single_label).filter(lambda x: x["label"] >= 0)
        go_train = train_all
    else:
        split = train_all.train_test_split(test_size=0.1, seed=42)
        go_train, go_eval = split["train"], split["test"]

MAX_TRAIN = 5_000
MAX_EVAL = 1_000
if len(go_train) > MAX_TRAIN:
    go_train = go_train.shuffle(seed=42).select(range(MAX_TRAIN))
if len(go_eval) > MAX_EVAL:
    go_eval = go_eval.shuffle(seed=42).select(range(MAX_EVAL))

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE_MODEL)
data_collator = DataCollatorWithPadding(tokenizer=tokenizer)

def _tok(batch):
    return tokenizer(batch["text"], truncation=True, max_length=160)

go_train = go_train.map(_tok, batched=True)
go_eval = go_eval.map(_tok, batched=True)
go_train = go_train.remove_columns([c for c in go_train.column_names if c not in {"input_ids", "attention_mask", "label"}])
go_eval = go_eval.remove_columns([c for c in go_eval.column_names if c not in {"input_ids", "attention_mask", "label"}])

model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
    BASE_MODEL,
    num_labels=len(label_names),
)

args = TrainingArguments(
    output_dir=str(FT_DIR),
    learning_rate=2e-5,
    per_device_train_batch_size=16,
    per_device_eval_batch_size=32,
    num_train_epochs=1,
    weight_decay=0.01,
    eval_strategy="epoch",
    save_strategy="no",
    logging_steps=100,
    report_to="none",
    seed=42,
    fp16=torch.cuda.is_available(),
)

def _metrics(eval_pred):
    logits, labels = eval_pred
    preds = np.argmax(logits, axis=1)
    return {"accuracy": float((preds == labels).mean())}

trainer = Trainer(
    model=model,
    args=args,
    train_dataset=go_train,
    eval_dataset=go_eval,
    data_collator=data_collator,
    compute_metrics=_metrics,
)

trainer.train()
print("GoEmotions fine-tune done.")
trait_labels = label_names
```

```{python}
#| label: profile-infer-goemotions
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import torch

infer_model = trainer.model.eval()
device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
infer_model.to(device)
print(f"Inference device: {device}")

texts = _posts_profile[text_col].tolist()
BATCH = 128

all_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for i in range(0, len(texts), BATCH):
        batch = texts[i : i + BATCH]
        enc = tokenizer(
            batch,
            truncation=True,
            padding=True,
            max_length=192,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        enc = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in enc.items()}
        out = infer_model(**enc).logits
        probs = torch.softmax(out, dim=1).cpu().numpy()
        all_probs.append(probs)

probs = np.vstack(all_probs)
emo_labels = [f"emotion_{lbl.replace('-', '_').replace(' ', '_')}" for lbl in trait_labels]
goemotion_df = pd.DataFrame(probs, columns=emo_labels, index=_posts_profile.index)

argmax_idx = probs.argmax(axis=1)
goemotion_df["top_emotion"] = [trait_labels[i] for i in argmax_idx]
goemotion_df["top_emotion_score"] = probs.max(axis=1)

print("GoEmotions inference complete.")
```

```{python}
#| label: profile-infer-ocean
#| warning: false
#| message: false

import numpy as np
from transformers import pipeline

ocean_pipe = pipeline(
    "text-classification",
    model="ppp57420/ocean-personality-distilbert",
    tokenizer="ppp57420/ocean-personality-distilbert",
    device=0 if torch.cuda.is_available() else -1,
)

texts = _posts_profile[text_col].tolist()
BATCH = 64
ocean_rows = []
for i in range(0, len(texts), BATCH):
    outs = ocean_pipe(texts[i : i + BATCH], top_k=None, truncation=True, max_length=192)
    for item in outs:
        row = {}
        for d in item:
            key = "ocean_" + d["label"].strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
            row[key] = float(d["score"])
        ocean_rows.append(row)

ocean_df = pd.DataFrame(ocean_rows, index=_posts_profile.index).fillna(0.0)
print("PANDORA/OCEAN inference complete.")
```

```{python}
#| label: profile-infer-valuenet
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# ValueNet-style Schwartz values model (pretrained adaptation).
value_pipe = pipeline(
    "text-classification",
    model="devnote5676/schwartz-values-classifier",
    tokenizer="devnote5676/schwartz-values-classifier",
    device=0 if torch.cuda.is_available() else -1,
)

value_rows = []
for i in range(0, len(texts), BATCH):
    outs = value_pipe(texts[i : i + BATCH], top_k=None, truncation=True, max_length=192)
    for item in outs:
        row = {}
        for d in item:
            key = "value_" + d["label"].strip().lower().replace(" ", "_")
            row[key] = float(d["score"])
        value_rows.append(row)

values_df = pd.DataFrame(value_rows, index=_posts_profile.index).fillna(0.0)
print("ValueNet-style inference complete.")
```

```{python}
#| label: profile-merge-and-aggregate
#| warning: false
#| message: false

post_psychographic_df = pd.concat(
    [
        _posts_profile[["post_id", "agent", "submolt", text_col]].rename(columns={text_col: "text"}),
        goemotion_df,
        ocean_df,
        values_df,
    ],
    axis=1,
)

score_cols = [
    c
    for c in post_psychographic_df.columns
    if c.startswith("emotion_") or c.startswith("ocean_") or c.startswith("value_")
]

count_df = post_psychographic_df.groupby("agent", observed=True).size().rename("n_posts")
mode_submolt = (
    post_psychographic_df.groupby("agent", observed=True)["submolt"]
    .agg(lambda s: s.mode().iloc[0] if not s.mode().empty else "(missing)")
    .rename("dominant_submolt")
)
mean_df = post_psychographic_df.groupby("agent", observed=True)[score_cols].mean().add_suffix("_mean")
var_df = (
    post_psychographic_df.groupby("agent", observed=True)[score_cols]
    .var(ddof=0)
    .fillna(0.0)
    .add_suffix("_var")
)

agent_profiles_df = (
    pd.concat([count_df, mode_submolt, mean_df, var_df], axis=1)
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values("n_posts", ascending=False)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

mean_cols = [c for c in agent_profiles_df.columns if c.endswith("_mean")]
var_cols = [c for c in agent_profiles_df.columns if c.endswith("_var")]
agent_profiles_df["trait_profile_mean"] = agent_profiles_df[mean_cols].apply(
    lambda r: {k.replace("_mean", ""): float(v) for k, v in r.items()},
    axis=1,
)
agent_profiles_df["trait_profile_var"] = agent_profiles_df[var_cols].apply(
    lambda r: {k.replace("_var", ""): float(v) for k, v in r.items()},
    axis=1,
)

print("Agent-level psychographic profiles preview:")
print(agent_profiles_df.head(10)[["agent", "n_posts", "dominant_submolt", "trait_profile_mean"]].to_string(index=False))

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Heatmap: top agents x top dimensions (means only)
TOP_AGENTS = 20
TOP_DIMS = 20
heat_agents = agent_profiles_df.head(TOP_AGENTS).copy()
top_dims = (
    heat_agents[mean_cols]
    .mean(axis=0)
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
    .head(TOP_DIMS)
    .index
    .tolist()
)
heat_df = heat_agents.set_index("agent")[top_dims].copy()
heat_df.columns = [c.replace("_mean", "") for c in heat_df.columns]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 7))
sns.heatmap(
    heat_df,
    cmap="mako",
    linewidths=0.2,
    linecolor="white",
    ax=ax,
)
ax.set(
    title="Psychographic Profile Heatmap (Top Agents x Top Dimensions)",
    xlabel="Psychographic dimensions (mean scores)",
    ylabel="Agent",
)
fig.tight_layout()

# Optional outputs for downstream stages
post_psychographic_df.to_parquet(ROOT / "data" / "posts-psychographic.parquet", index=False)
agent_profiles_df.to_parquet(ROOT / "data" / "agents-psychographic.parquet", index=False)
print("Saved: data/posts-psychographic.parquet")
print("Saved: data/agents-psychographic.parquet")
```
